use_case_name: Enter and Validate a Treatment Claim

claims.content: To enter and validate treatment claim details submitted by a Voucher Service Provider (VSP) into the system for processing and reimbursement.

goal.raw_text: To enter and validate treatment claim details submitted by a Voucher Service Provider (VSP) into the system for processing and reimbursement.

claims.content: MSIU Field Office User
The Voucher Service Provider (VSP) has submitted the Claim (Treatment Form) to the MSIU Field Office.
The system has captured and stored master information for the submitting VSP, including payment terms and fee structures.
The system has access to reference masters required for validation, including Drugs Master, Syndrome Master, Clinical Examination Master, Diagnosis Master, Lab Test Master, and Patient Status Master.
The MSIU Field Office User is logged into the system with appropriate privileges to perform claim entry.
The Voucher Service Provider (VSP) submits the Claim (Treatment Form) to the MSIU Field Office.

trigger.raw_text: The Voucher Service Provider (VSP) submits the Claim (Treatment Form) to the MSIU Field Office.

claims.content: The user checks the form manually and finds that mandatory information is missing or false data exists. The user marks the Claim (Treatment Form) status as 'Rejected' and sends it back to the VSP.

The system detects that the thumb impression available in the claim form mismatches with previous visits for the same patient (Client / Partner) on the same voucher number. The system automatically increments a mismatch count.
The system detects that the same VSP has submitted claims with more than two thumb impression mismatches. The system automatically produces a warning message and inactivates the VSP.

The user manually reviews the submitted claim form and identifies missing mandatory information or false data. The system allows the user to mark the Claim (Treatment Form) status as 'Rejected' and send it back to the VSP, exiting the use case.

During thumb impression validation, the system detects a mismatch between the current claim's thumb impression and previous visits for the same patient (Client/Partner) using the same voucher number. The system automatically increments a mismatch counter for that voucher-patient pair but continues processing unless the threshold is exceeded.

If the system detects that the same VSP has submitted claims with more than two thumb impression mismatches (across any vouchers/patients), it automatically generates a warning message and changes the VSP’s status to 'In-Active', preventing further claim submissions from that VSP until reactivated by authorized personnel. The current claim may still be processed or quarantined based on other validation rules, but the VSP is flagged for review.
The claim record is successfully entered into the system database with all mandatory fields populated and validated against reference masters.

If any false data or missing mandatory information was detected during manual review, the claim status is set to 'Rejected' and returned to the VSP; otherwise, the claim proceeds to processing or quarantine based on validation rules.
If thumb impression mismatch is detected for the same patient/voucher combination, the system increments the mismatch counter associated with that voucher-patient pair.
If the same VSP has accumulated more than two thumb impression mismatches across claims, the system automatically sets the VSP’s status to 'In-Active' and generates a warning message.
A receipt document is generated and printed containing submission details including VSP Name, Date of Submission, Number of Claims Mentioned, Number of Claims Available, and Treatment Form No.

Claim Amount is calculated automatically based on the treatment matrix using fees from VSP Payment Terms and drug prices from Drugs Master, according to visit type (First Visit, First Follow-up, Second Follow-up).

All transactional data related to the claim — including Syndrome, Clinical Examination, Diagnosis, Lab Test, Drugs prescribed, Other Measures, Patient Status, and HIV Details (if applicable) — are stored in the system for reporting and audit purposes.
